saw_lines: Martial arts buyers pick gear by discipline and fit, then come back for replacements when a sparring session wears one out.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a fighter checks the discipline and fit before clicking.
Your site shows 1500 reviews and 75000 customers, yet 0 of 17 ads use them. Print 1500 on the creative and in line one, then open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 1500 reviews and 75000 customers, yet 0 of 17 ads carry either number, so buyers get no proof before the click. Print 1500 on the creative and in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.
4 of 9 copy ads open on the same flash sale line, and 0 of 9 mention an offer, so the opener promises a deal the ad never shows. Test two openers on the BJJ gi and boxing gloves against it.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 17 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a first time buyer clicks without knowing when the gear arrives. Open the new ads for first time buyers with one shipping line from your shipping page.
One exact copy runs in 4 of 9 ads, so the same words reach buyers again and again. Keep the body of the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each of those four ads.

ads_1: Gi, gloves and rashguard creative led by review quotes, replacing the flash sale opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
